package rulefixtures

import "net/http"

// scenario for api_error_type_outside_transport_package: API-facing error payload structs living in persistence or business packages instead of transport-boundary packages.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

type UserRepository struct{}

type APIError struct {
	HTTPStatus int    `json:"-"`
	Code       string `json:"code"`
	Message    string `json:"message"`
	Details    any    `json:"details,omitempty"`
}

var (
	ErrUserNotFound   = &APIError{HTTPStatus: http.StatusNotFound, Code: "USER_NOT_FOUND", Message: "user not found"}
	ErrInvalidEmail   = &APIError{HTTPStatus: http.StatusBadRequest, Code: "INVALID_EMAIL", Message: "email format is invalid"}
	ErrDuplicateEntry = &APIError{HTTPStatus: http.StatusConflict, Code: "DUPLICATE_ENTRY", Message: "resource already exists"}
)

func (r *UserRepository) FindByEmail(email string) (*User, *APIError) {
	if email == "" {
		return nil, ErrInvalidEmail
	}
	return nil, ErrUserNotFound
}

type User struct {
	ID    int
	Email string
}
